name: Triple Creek Ranch
positioning: Relais & Chateaux ranch in Montana's Bitterroot Mountains, with private log cabins and ranch homes and nightly rates that include meals, beverages and most activities
best_for: Couples wanting a private log cabin in the pines or on the Bitterroot River, with rates designed for two
Outdoor lovers who want year-round horseback riding, hiking, archery and more included in the rate

facts.text: Triple Creek Ranch is set in the Bitterroot Mountain Range of the Montana Rockies.
Triple Creek Ranch has been a Montana hideaway since 1986.
Triple Creek Ranch has been a member of Relais & Chateaux since 1996.
Accommodations are private log ranch cabins and ranch homes with easy access to the lodge.
The lodge and its surroundings feature a curated collection of original Western art.
Nightly cabin rates include meals, beverages and most activities and are designed for two people.
Horseback riding, hiking, snowshoeing, a fly-casting clinic, mountain biking, archery, sapphire panning and tennis are included in the nightly cabin rate.
Horseback riding at Triple Creek Ranch is a year-round activity.
Experienced wranglers accompany all horseback trips, and trail ride groups are kept small.
Group yoga and meditation classes are offered most days and held outdoors as often as weather and temperatures allow.
Lost Trail Powder Mountain Ski Area, on the Continental Divide at the Montana-Idaho border, is about a 30 minute drive from the ranch.
Meals are served in the vaulted-ceiling Dining Room or delivered to the cabin, and the dress code is ranch casual.

highlights.text: Cabins range from secluded spots in the pines or on the banks of the Bitterroot River to cabins steps from the lodge and the outdoor pool.
The guided Scenic Drive tours the CB Ranch and the Bitterroot Valley looking for elk, mule deer, whitetail and bison.
Guests can float the Bitterroot River with an experienced fly-fishing guide; all fishing there is catch and release.
Activities from horseback riding and archery to sapphire panning are included in the nightly cabin rate.

considerations.text: Add-on adventures such as guided fly-fishing, scenic river floats, cattle drives, whitewater rafting and ATV tours carry additional fees.
May and June can bring high water with limited fishing and scenic float availability due to snow melt.
For safety, the ranch cannot accept horseback riders over 250 lbs.
